findings.passage: Frankly, we’re sick and tired of too much government and these changes [in NFA registration enforcement] represent a step in the right direction, of getting back to the Second Amendment and the constitutional rights that our Founding Fathers gave us.
findings.note: Quoted by Breitbart after he bought a suppressor over the counter without National Firearms Act registration, under a federal court ruling that protects members of a gun-rights group. He calls the loosening of registration enforcement a step in the right direction.
subjects: repeal National Firearms Act rules on suppressors

findings.passage: I wouldn’t allow you to change the Second Amendment just as I wouldn’t allow you to change the First Amendment.
findings.note: Remark at a Phoenix Second Amendment rally, as transcribed by a newsletter author (not an own-site source). The month comes from the Tucson Sentinel URL for the same event, which could not be read.
